text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Gracing the end of year with one final
show, it's
the Arima Kinen! All the fan
favorites are here!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Including two sisters that I'm sure each
and every fan has been waiting to see
race! That's right, both Biwa Hayahide
and Narita Brian are here
today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What do you think strength is, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Is it being able to compete against
anyone? Is it
possessing an unwavering
heart?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I think it's being able to stand up on
your own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if you have no power, or if your
spirit is
broken...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's about not accepting the comfort of
lying
down—whether or not you have the
will to try and
stand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand on my own two feet, like
everyone
who's come before, and carry
onward as far as I
can.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But not from the back or the
front—I want
you watching from by my
side.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So let's walk the same road together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm expecting a lot from you
today,
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haaa! My heart is pounding a little!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can be as cool as those two!
They shine
bright like stars!
